raw:
Useful literature would cover three areas:
- Operation interactions within NAS-Bench-201 cells, i.e. epistasis between edges.
- Analyses of which architectural features drive accuracy, such as skip connections on the input-to-output edge, convolutions on the path, and cells that disconnect when 'none' edges remove every route.
- Whether accuracy rankings transfer across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet16-120.
